queries: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM invoice_averages), adjusted AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_adjusted_deviation FROM deviations), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_adjusted_deviation IS NULL, country_adjusted_deviation DESC) AS position FROM adjusted) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, country_adjusted_deviation FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY country_adjusted_deviation IS NULL, country_adjusted_deviation DESC, InvoiceId;

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM invoice_averages), country_averages AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS difference_from_country_average FROM deviations), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference_from_country_average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_country_average DESC) AS position FROM country_averages) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, difference_from_country_average FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference_from_country_average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_country_average DESC, InvoiceId;
